name: Signal Transport
description: Signal message transport for Sable's local bridge runtime.

commands.name: /bridgestatus
commands.description: Report bridge configuration and link-server state.

commands.name: /ops
commands.description: Report bridge, scheduler, and research health.

commands.name: /setavatar
commands.description: Update the Signal profile avatar through the live Signal session.

requiredConfig.name: ALLOWED_NUMBERS
requiredConfig.description: Comma-separated Signal senders allowed to use the bridge.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_SIGNAL_ATTACHMENT_QUEUE_DIR
requiredConfig.description: Queue directory for out-of-band attachment sends.

privateDataPolicy: Do not store phone numbers, Signal sessions, message history, or attachment contents in the plugin manifest.
